targets.query: from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "load1") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "load1")
from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_response") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "estado_binario") |> mean() |> yield(name: "disponibilidad")
from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_response") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "estado_binario") |> last() |> yield(name: "estado")

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "usage_idle" and r.cpu == "cpu-total") |> mean() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: 100.0 - r._value })) |> yield(name: "CPU")

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mem") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "used_percent") |> mean() |> yield(name: "mem")

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disk") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "used_percent") |> mean() |> yield(name: "disk")

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "api_requests_total") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: sum, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "requests")

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "inference_time_seconds_bucket") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "inference")

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "face_recognition_total" and r.result == "success") |> sum() |> yield(name: "exitosos")

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "face_recognition_total" and r.result == "failure") |> sum() |> yield(name: "fallidos")
from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "uptime") |> last() |> yield(name: "uptime")
